text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, what's wrong, Tannhauser?
You're
practically tearing your hair out.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Were you making some marvelous plans
for the
school? Or do you want to
practice sending
letters by arrow?
Whatever it is, I'm here to listen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Nature... I'm so worried about
how I did
in the unit exam...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, but I'm so worried... The material in
the
exam was pretty difficult this time.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I really hope I didn't fail again! Please
don't make
me do any more extra
lessons!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
What? What's so refreshing about this?!
If you
know some secret way of calming
down, please
teach meee!
